meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂目标拆解成有依据的步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂目标不知如何拆分
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex goals into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to break down complex goals

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 把复杂任务拆解成细小的步骤，每一步都记录可验证的证据，并严格检查；执行前先注册目标，必要时派出子代理并行工作，所有进展统一记录。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”、“ulw”等关键词，或要求持久目标执行等长期任务时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 拆解并执行这个任务。
say.note: 会先注册目标再分解步骤。

say.text: 启动 ulw 循环，目标是修复登录问题。
say.note: 按证据链逐步执行并记录。

say.text: 用持久目标模式帮我完成发布流程。
say.note: 会以检查点方式长期跟进。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude break work into small steps, record evidence for each, and check before continuing; it registers goals first, may spawn subagents for parallel work, and tracks progress in a unified state.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'ulw-loop' or 'ulw', or asks for durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break down and run this task.
say_en.note: Registers a goal first, then decomposes.

say_en.text: Start an ulw loop to fix the login bug.
say_en.note: Proceeds step by step with recorded evidence.

say_en.text: Run this release as a durable goal.
say_en.note: Tracks it with checkpoints over time.
